reason: Every factual claim holds against the source and the live page. Driven at file://.../master.html?v=approach&state={phone,desk,print,owner-flight}: in all four the only heading inside .tl-stage is H2 "Behind you" (render-b.js:104) - the received artifact has no h1, so heading navigation lands on what is already over. .b-measure carries role="list" (render-b.js:94) with 8 element children, 0 of role listitem: 7 role-less .b-item divs plus the decorative .b-rail (render-b.js:62,81), so the aria-label "What is still ahead, nearest first" names an empty list, the rail is an invalid child, and every milestone is orphaned generic text. .b-field is a DIV with aria-label "The plan for Mara & Finn" and no role (render-b.js:131) - naming is prohibited on the generic role, so the label is dropped; the live dump flags it as the one orphan label in the artifact. And the column's unit exists only in the .b-measureHead paragraph outside the list (render-b.js:90), with the row itself a bare .b-away number, so each row reads "16 Menu tasting at The Orchard Sat 1 Aug". This is not restating a gate: interaction-check.mjs asserts accessible names on interactive elements only (line 78-93) and audit.mjs covers palette/weights/contrast/targets/radii/motion/ramp/leading - neither looks at headings, list ownership or orphan labels. It is exactly the paid-for lesson "State carried only visually ... Named regions, real headings, a true accessibility tree" (lessons.md:71-73) creeping back on the one surface the brief says decides everything. No constraint is broken: the h1 stays at the existing 11px mono .b-who and the fix already pins weight 400, which it must - the UA h1 default of 700 would trip the audit weights gate. The fix is right in substance but imprecise in two places, sharpened below.
sharpenedFix: Keep three parts of the proposed fix as written: horizon() renders h("h1.b-who", ...) with .b-who { font-weight: 400 } added to b.css (mandatory - the UA h1 default is 700 and would fail audit.mjs weights; .b-who is also used as a p in publish/ended/owner-empty where 400 is already the computed value, so nothing moves visually); .b-item gets role: "listitem"; .b-rail gets "aria-hidden": "true". Change two. (1) Do NOT put aria-label on the listitem. role="listitem" does not take presentational children, so the row's visible text stays in the buffer and NVDA/VoiceOver announce the label and then the same row again - spoken and visible text diverge and every row is heard twice. Put the missing unit in real text instead: inside the row, after h("span.b-away.num"), append h("span.b-vh", { text: " days away" }) and add .b-vh { position:absolute; width:1px; height:1px; overflow:hidden; clip-path:inset(50%); white-space:nowrap; } to b.css, so the row reads "16 days away, Menu tasting at The Orchard, Sat 1 Aug" with no override and no duplication; do the same for the two marks that are currently fill-only - append " the day itself" on data-anchor and " the next thing" on data-lead. Re-run audit.mjs after adding .b-vh to confirm the clipped span is not picked up by the contrast or ramp scan. (2) The landmark change must not be made in field() alone: print builds h("div.b-print.b-field") inline (states.print) and day, ended, loading and unfurl also construct .b-field directly, so a change only to field() leaves print - which the finding's own gate assertion covers - without the landmark. Change every .b-field construction to h("section.b-field", { "aria-label": ... }) rather than main: a labelled section is a region landmark, valid both in this lab and when this language moves to Home, Notes and Tasks inside an app shell that already owns the document's single main, and print needs the aria-label added since it currently has none. In interaction-check.mjs scope the new assertions to the .tl-stage subtree (the shell has no h1 or main today, but the assertions should not depend on that): exactly one h1 per state naming the project across phone, desk, print, owner-flight; .b-measure [role="listitem"] count equals .b-item count and no non-listitem element child sits inside the role="list"; every row's accessible name contains its own date and the word "days"; and no element inside the stage carries aria-label without a role or a native semantic.
